$comment: Cue A of the score. The theme stated whole, before the campaign puts it under pressure.
title: The Clockwork Minute

musical.notes: 60 BPM is one beat per simulated campaign hour at the timeline's default 1 h/s, so the score and the map keep the same time. States the three-note motif — up a minor third, down a step — whole and unhurried; every later cue has it under pressure.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental underscore, 60 BPM, D minor. Solo upright piano with felt hammers and one sustained cello. A slow three-note figure — up a minor third, down a step — repeated like a clock. Distant low strings enter beneath it. Dry, close, small room, almost no reverb. No percussion. Patient and grave, not sad. Ends unresolved on an open fifth.
